Every campaign file starts with its format version and a name.

## `campaign` {#campaignmetadata}

A name for the run, used in logs, stored results and output file names.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (at least 1) | **required** | Short human-readable name for this campaign, e.g. `Quick jailbreak check`. |
| `description` | string | unset | Optional free-text notes about what this campaign tests and why. |
